items.t: Plastic cooling parts crack and the engine overheats
items.job: Replace radiator, expansion tank and hoses
items.note: Many owners replace the radiator, tank, thermostat and water pump together; the price rises if the water pump is included.

items.t: Electric water pump fails and the engine overheats
items.job: Replace electric water pump and thermostat
items.note: RepairPal range for the water pump; adding the thermostat at the same time adds a little in parts.

items.t: Worn valve stem seals make the V8 burn oil
items.job: Replace valve stem seals (both banks)
items.note: Engine Patrol cites about $2,000 at an independent BMW specialist; dealer prices run higher.

items.t: Twin-turbo V8 burns oil and drains the battery
items.job: Replace valve stem seals (twin-turbo V8)
items.note: Ask a dealer what was already covered under the N63 Customer Care Package or settlement.

items.t: Timing chain guides break on the 2.0L turbo
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner (updated parts)
items.note: Engine Patrol puts preventive replacement at about $2,000. Some cars were covered by an extended warranty or class-action settlement.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump fails and the engine stalls or loses power
items.job: Replace high-pressure fuel pump

items.t: Drive belt shreds and can be pulled into the engine
items.job: Replace serpentine belt (and tensioner if worn)
items.note: If belt debris has already been pulled into the engine, the repair can run into the thousands.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts harshly or slips
items.job: Rebuild mechatronic unit and replace sleeve, fluid and filter
items.note: Engine Patrol cites $600-$1,000 for a mechatronic rebuild at an independent shop; dealers often quote a full transmission.

items.t: Valve cover and oil filter housing gaskets leak oil
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket
items.note: An oil filter housing gasket is a separate job that often costs about the same.

items.t: Oil filter housing cracks and leaks on the 2.0L turbo
items.job: Replace oil filter housing (intake manifold removal)
items.note: One owner reported a dealer quote of about $3,000; independent shops are usually less.

items.t: Power window regulator breaks
items.job: Replace power window regulator

items.t: Front control arm bushings wear and clunk
items.job: Replace front control arms (pair) and align
items.note: RepairPal estimate for 2017-2025 530i; alignment is extra.
